items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I remember we were talking to a wonderful black old man... Jackie Robinson had just broken into baseball... I am sitting out there and loving this so

ctx.x: Yes, Just misunderstanding. I remember we were talking to a wonderful black old man, out at the sitting out at the ballgame in Chicago, Cubs game, sitting out in the bleachers park and Jackie Robinson had just broken into baseball and he as you know was a superstar and he was having a fantastic day, his first day playing with the Chicago Cubs, and Jackie was the only black man in baseball and of course, he was a big star and a big attraction and he had sold the place out.

And I am sitting out there and loving this so, because we had been through that years ago with musicians, I mean, we were always -- record dates were always black and white, and we were always trying to get together and we were always having jam sessions and respecting one another. Good, dear friends.
